findings.text: blocking: the commit 85df5f3562b7d20bf3de720eb4f416b9971c1639 that rewrote the remaining refusal cases is absent from the object store - git cat-file -t, git show and git log -1 all answer 'bad object' in both this worktree and the main checkout, while only rev-list resolves it from the commit-graph - so the reviewed history cannot be walked through it, the manifest's commits list omits it, and promotion cannot read that commit's message or diff to audit it.

non-blocking: the landing fragment records its measure at head d366c92e51 as 9 failed / 247 passed against 9 failed / 243 passed at base, while the gate arms stored for the landed head report 10 failed / 264 passed at cc5e7cfe84 and 10 failed / 260 passed at 7aa21029e0, and no log left in the run directory carries the fragment's figures; a reader comparing the landed evidence to the arms beside it finds numbers that reconcile with no log.

non-blocking: the backlog= keyword added at the five held-dispatch call sites (2168, 2404, 2483, 2528, 2600) has no assertion that reddens if it is dropped - no test reads the pointer a held dispatch stores before admission, and the admission launch re-records unreconciled_override under source 'admission-launch', so removing the keyword leaves every gate green while the queued request silently stops naming the backlog it was made over.
